row.title: The backup site deploy script must ship the stamped entry module
row.body: deploy/deploy-site.mjs uploaded site/worker.js directly, so a deploy through it would have dropped the recency stamp that lives in site/edge.js. It now collects modules from site/edge.js and takes main_module and the VERSION check from the collected modules.

title: The backup site deploy script must ship the stamped entry module
